cause: Test35 raised parent object ids to 0xfffd but the engine encodes object keys (notify/endon wait lists, object-keyed arrays) as names 0x10000+id and decodes them with six '< 0x19000' checks sized for 0x9000 ids. Keys >= 0x9000 were treated as integer indices: no reference held, not marked for save, wrong on load. Waiting threads were freed while wait lists still pointed at them; their ids were reused; the VM resumed non-threads (0x227ddc) and double releases corrupted the free lists (false 'exceeded' errors).
